market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a little-known state deputy from PSOL, a minor left-wing party. In Brazil's highly polarized national elections, the second-place finisher is always a major candidate from the dominant left or right coalition. Historical support for PSOL presidential candidates is below 1%, making a top-two finish extraordinarily unlikely.
evidence_points: PSOL presidential candidate Guilherme Boulos received 0.58% of valid votes in the 2018 first round.
2022 first round was dominated by Lula (48.4%) and Bolsonaro (43.2%); no minor party candidate came close.
Renan Santos has no national profile and would face multiple stronger candidates from both ideological blocs.
